description: def main(), do: dbg(Map.update!(1, :a, fn x -> x end)) panics the compiler: 'index out of bounds: the len is 0 but the index is 0' at src/compiler2/jobs/runtime_demand.rs:1294 (out.input_demands[index].join_assign), on 44174db13 and d9c9a842c. A compiler panic is a fault whatever the program. Find why input_demands is empty for a clause with params, fix at its source, and pin the program as a fixture (it must raise BadMapError at run time once the BadMapError ticket lands; until then, at least compile).
title: A Map.update! on a non-map does not panic the compiler
